patterns: APPSC asks one-fact items on Reddi culture: Puriti Pannu (Racha Vema), Sangeeta Chintamani (Pedakomati), Haravilasam (sea trade), Surambika's tank, Ghatika Yantra, Srinatha's works.
Chronological ordering of rulers (Anavota -> Anavema -> Kumaragiri -> Pedakomati) is a recurring G2 shape.
Key slips exist (Puriti Pannu keyed to Kataya Vema; tank name differs across years) - read options carefully.
App goes much deeper into Rajahmundry-line politics (Allada, Veerabhanu Deva, Mallappa Odayar) and pan-dynasty title lists than any PYQ.
App leans on multi-statement and match items; APPSC uses direct single-answer MCQs here.
